name: Rossweisse
source:
An ancient hero from a dying world.

In her original world, it seems that all the ancient heroes except Mu and her have perished. Originally, she was powerful enough to kill a sealed beast-class monster by herself, but maybe it's because the world we're in now has lost its potential, that her power has been lost.
